name: Biomedical Engineering
boundaries: Biomedical Engineering: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: Added: BME-11. Chronic spinal cord reconstruction is also covered by BME-03. A universal master pathway and reversal of every listed condition remain unproven.
Covered: BME-04. BME-16 addresses a related implant-interface barrier. Millions of neurons, decades of stability, and zero foreign-body response are not assumed necessary.
Added in narrowed form: BME-16. The useful underlying capability is durable, functional tissue integration across implant classes; one perfect material for every device is unestablished.

Added in narrowed form: BME-15. Deep-body molecular imaging with substantial access and clinical benefits qualifies; the simultaneous universal specifications and wholesale replacement claims remain speculative.
Added: BME-13. Existing closed-loop insulin systems are progress toward part of this concept, not evidence that the full proposal has been achieved.

original_dispositions.original_title: In-vivo bioprinting or directed tissue assembly
original_dispositions.reason: Added: BME-17. BME-01 covers external organ manufacturing; BME-11 covers in-place regeneration.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal targeted non-viral gene editing and reprogramming
original_dispositions.reason: Covered in core delivery capability: BME-02. The entry does not assume a non-viral vehicle is the only solution, nor that delivery alone can cure every genetic disease, cancer, or degenerative condition.

Added in narrowed form: BME-18. Long-lived, clinically useful multianalyte sensing is the central capability; zero external power, universal biomarkers, and automatic disease prevention are not established requirements.

Covered in core intervention-prediction capability: BME-10. Whole-body completeness, near-perfect accuracy, and an end to unexpected device failure are not established or necessary for the proposed breakthrough.
Added in narrowed form: BME-14. Oxygen delivery and bleeding control can be provided by separate validated products; complete lifelong immune replacement is not assumed necessary.

reconciliation_change_log.change: BME-01–BME-10 retained: Their concepts and IDs remain intact.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Completion criteria are explicitly labeled as proposals, and results are distinguished from the broader capabilities.

reconciliation_change_log.change: BME-11 added: Adult in-place organ regeneration is distinct from manufacturing an organ outside the body and from spinal cord repair.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical “master switch” is treated as an unproven possibility, not a prerequisite.

reconciliation_change_log.change: BME-12 added: Scalable xenotransplantation deserves separate treatment from organ manufacturing because its source, immune barriers, and evidence are distinct.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Its previous exclusion solely to avoid an organ-supply overlap was too restrictive.

reconciliation_change_log.change: BME-13–BME-18 added: Artificial organs, blood-function replacement, deep molecular imaging, durable implant interfaces, in-body tissue assembly, and continuous biomarker sensing each address a distinct enabling capability.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Historical demands for perfection, universal applicability, or indefinite operation were narrowed where they were unnecessary to achieve revolutionary impact.
In particular, the 2026 organ-banking result is a preprint, the cancer-screening primary endpoint was negative, and several first-pass sources could not be fully inspected again.
